title: Remember the Silver-Root Court: Name at the Gate
description: Remember the Silver-Root Court: Name at the Gate is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate (Sealed Gate with fae time bleed). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Dagda, Morrigan, Brigid, Lugh enters; this beat spotlights Morrigan as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the entry step at Silver-Root Court, using living mound-gate maze and geas trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: Avalora is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Silver-Root Court and reveals: How fae time pools bend cooldowns and memory. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Mesopotamia, Ziggurat Steps. mudbrick stepped pyramids rising from the flat alluvial plain, irrigation channels cracked by Gate-fractures, reed houses collapsing into void-mist, cuneiform tablets scattered. The avatar battles the Hollow in their mythological homeland, ancient era. No faction advantage — Earth is neutral ground.
